effect: Adding the protein threads completed the muscle fibers and the chapter. The final picture shows that the filaments overlap more as the repeating unit shortens, while the filaments themselves keep their length.
reaction: That detail was satisfying because it clarified how the structures can produce shortening.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because it brought the cell components together and showed how their organization supports shortening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the nuclei and mitochondria was straightforward slot filling, though the accompanying explanations gave both actions useful context.

surprise.text: I was interested that the filaments keep their length while their overlap increases and the repeating unit shortens.

arbitrary.text: Adding mineral salts was prompted by the picture, but their specific role in completing the cell-fluid model was less clear than the roles of the membrane and channels.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these muscle cells are organized into tissue and connected to other body systems. The final construction made that progression interesting.
